description: Source code for a real-time voice agent example using Grok Voice Agent API, demonstrating voice interactions, tool integrations, function calling, and pipeline setup.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining functions callable by the LLM, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for grouping multiple tools, including standard tools like weather, time, and restaurant recommendations.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for LLM execution in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a sequence of processing steps for the voice agent.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters, timeout, and observers.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context for the LLM, including initial messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs for aggregating user and assistant turns in the conversation.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Configuration for voice options and instructions for the Grok session.

classes.name: GrokRealtimeLLMService
classes.description: Service for interacting with Grok's real-time LLM API.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Parameters for handling function call responses.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract base class for transport mechanisms.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Handles weather function calls, returning weather info.

methods.name: get_current_time
methods.description: Handles time function calls, returning current time and date.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the voice agent pipeline with given transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creating transport and starting the run.
